speaker: Patient
text: 4-day-old newborn. The newborn was born at term with no complications. The mother had no prenatal care and has a history of gonorrhea treated 4 years ago. The newborn presents with a generalized rash that has been present for 1 day.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Neonatal Gonococcal Dermatitis.

Based on your history of untreated gonorrhea four years ago, this severe, pustular rash appearing at four days of life is highly suspicious for congenital *Neisseria gonorrhoeae* infection. I am requesting immediate Gram stain and culture of the rash lesions to confirm the diagnosis. REQUEST TEST: Rash_Gram_Stain and Culture; REQUEST IMAGES: Rash_Clinical_Photo.
